noSecret.title: Nothing to show
noSecret.body: This page is where Stripe sends you after a payment.

received.title: Order received
received.body: Your receipt is on its way by email.

succeeded.title: Thank you
succeeded.body: The payment went through and the order is in.
succeeded.footer: Stripe has emailed your receipt. Anything printed is sent to the printer automatically, and download links follow by email.

processing.title: Payment processing
processing.body: Your bank is still working on it. Nothing more is needed from you.
processing.footer: You will get an email once it settles.

failed.title: Payment not completed
failed.body: The card was not charged. Nothing has been sent.
failed.footer: You can try again from the store with the same cart.
